statements.impact_statement: The crawler uses Python and Requests default TLS verification and never enables X509_V_FLAG_OCSP_RESP_CHECK or X509_V_FLAG_OCSP_RESP_CHECK_ALL. The OpenSSL advisory states that only clients explicitly enabling those flags reach the affected path. The finding remains documented until OpenSSL 3.6.4 is available in the pinned runtime image.
